details: Tether, the issuer of the USDT stablecoin, announced a profit exceeding $1 billion for the first quarter of 2026, with its reserve buffer growing to a record $8.2 billion. The company also confirmed that an audit has commenced. This financial strength underscores Tether's stability amidst broader market fluctuations.
title: Tether Reports Over $1 Billion Q1 Profit, Reserve Buffer Reaches Record $8.2 Billion

details: Meta is integrating the USDC stablecoin to facilitate payments for its creators, utilizing both the Solana and Polygon blockchain networks. This move signifies a notable expansion of stablecoin utility and blockchain adoption within major mainstream platforms.
title: Meta Taps USDC for Creator Payments via Solana and Polygon

details: CoinDesk suggests that Bitcoin's primary narrative is shifting from a digital gold or inflation hedge to a digital collateral asset. This evolution is evidenced by major financial institutions, including JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley, increasingly integrating Bitcoin-linked assets into their lending and structured product offerings.
title: Bitcoin's Evolving Narrative: Digital Collateral Asset, Says CoinDesk

details: MoonPay has introduced a debit Mastercard that allows artificial intelligence (AI) agents to conduct payments using stablecoins. Built on the Mastercard network, this innovation represents a deeper integration of crypto into AI applications, expanding real-world use cases.
title: MoonPay Launches Stablecoin Debit Card for AI Agents on Mastercard

details: WisdomTree's crypto exchange-traded products (ETPs) recorded net inflows of $137 million during the first quarter of 2026. This trend highlights a sustained and growing institutional interest in digital asset investments through regulated financial products.
title: WisdomTree Crypto ETPs See $137 Million Net Inflows in Q1

details: Following a $293 million exploit on the Kelp restaking platform that saw hackers steal over 116,000 restaked ETH tokens and create bad debt on Aave, several decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols have formed "DeFi United" to stabilize rsETH and coordinate recovery efforts.
title: DeFi Protocols Unite to Back rsETH After $293M Kelp Restaking Exploit

details: Fun, a crypto onramping solution, successfully completed a Series A funding round, securing $72 million. The round was co-led by prominent venture capital firms Multicoin Capital and SignalFire, indicating continued investor confidence in crypto infrastructure development.
title: Crypto Onramping Solution Fun Raises $72 Million Series A

details: Porvenir, a pension fund based in Colombia, has introduced a new pension fund that incorporates cryptocurrencies. This initiative represents a significant step towards integrating digital assets into traditional financial services within the Latin American region.
title: Porvenir Launches Crypto Pension Fund in Colombia

details: Hundreds of previously inactive Ethereum wallets have been emptied, with researchers currently investigating the cause. Speculation ranges from the compromise of old private keys to vulnerabilities in outdated wallet tooling or other exposure mechanisms.
title: Someone Drained Dormant Ethereum Wallets, Cause Debated

details: The Ethereum-based meme coin ASTEROID experienced a nearly 30% surge in price after Elon Musk reportedly agreed to make it the official mascot of SpaceX. This follows a letter from the mother of the 15-year-old designer of the "Asteroid" Shiba Inu-style plush toy.
title: Ethereum Meme Coin ASTEROID Jumps 30% After Elon Musk Endorsement
